sum: The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index weights its component securities using a “modified market capitalization-weighted” methodology, which takes into account the market value of the component securities subject to certain weight restrictions pursuant to the index provider’s methodology. It is non-diversified.
